method: Renders r_w10 (head 5c779c1) diffed against r_w9 and compared with omaat_f11, f32, f57, f58, f60, up_34 and the official f_17313. Colours are PIL box means, compared as ratios within one image. Flute relief is the p90/p10 of the column-mean luminance across a leaf. Code: src/09d_suite.js (350 lines). Crops: scratchpad/qa10a/.

calibration.earlier_issue: w9a MED / w9b MED: the console module was a tall, hard-edged lectern (35 deg, 0.145 rise)
calibration.status: mostly fixed. Line 171 sets ka 22 deg and y1 0.675, so the window-side rise is about 0.09 including the lip. In q04 (qa10a/q04_mod.png) and q02 the module now reads as a low raised step with the dock and keypad on it. Line 190's dock is the rounder gRBox(0.10, 0.03, 0.23, 0.014, 2). Remaining: the hard, flat triangular end faces from the straight gExtrude (line 172) still show in s4 and s5 (low issue below).

calibration.earlier_issue: w9a MED / w9b LOW: the fold band read as a raised slab across the bed
calibration.status: band fixed, but the replacement is broken. The band is gone (q04 vs r_w9 q04). But the turned-down corner at line 300 is buried inside the duvet. gExtrude centres its depth, so the triangle spans y 0.542-0.564, while the duvet plateau (line 296: 0.50 - 0.03 + 0.065 + crown 0.045) is at 0.58. Only slivers poke out along the aisle and head edges, as small light steps (qa10a/q04_bed.png, bottom-left), and the omaat_f57 corner fold does not read at all. See issue 1.

calibration.earlier_issue: w9a MED / w9b LOW: fConsole and fInner were too light (module/cap 0.95)
calibration.status: fixed. Lines 25-26 add suite-only overrides. q04 module/cap is 107/181 = 0.59 (f57 0.67-0.74). q03 aisle box/shell is now about 1.0, against 1.1-1.35 in f_17313. Acceptable.

calibration.earlier_issue: w9a LOW: the window mirror was a full stadium and the centre corners too round
calibration.status: fixed. Lines 111-112 use r 0.032 / 0.024. The q03 crop (qa10a/q03_pier.png) shows a rounded rectangle with near-straight ends in a light frame, as in omaat_f11.

calibration.earlier_issue: w9a LOW: the centre mirror sat about 0.10 too low
calibration.status: fixed. Line 109 sets 0.14 x 0.36 at scy + 0.03. In the q02 crop (qa10a/q02_pier.png) the mirror top is level with the screen top, the lamp sits clear at the outer corner, and the corners are r about 0.03. Matches omaat_f32.

calibration.earlier_issue: w9a LOW / w9b LOW: the caps were neutral cream, not olive-khaki
calibration.status: fixed (deliberate middle hue, accepted). fCap #8f8a76 (line 24). The cap renders #c7c1ad (R-B +26) in v1 and #b9b6a5 (+20) in q04, between f_17313 and f60 #aaa584 (+38).

calibration.earlier_issue: w9a LOW / w9b LOW: the niche header was thin with small fillets
calibration.status: fixed. Line 278 makes the header 0.12 and line 280 sets fr 0.06. In s4 the header carries both lamps with rounded inner corners, close to omaat_f57.

calibration.earlier_issue: w9a LOW / w9b LOW: moire on the fluted leaves
calibration.status: partly fixed, with a side effect. fFluteGap #424037 (line 19) eases the stipple in q02, but a wavy alias is still visible in the s1 leaf (qa10a/s1leaf.png). The fluting has also lost relief: the v1 column p90/p10 is 1.07-1.11, against 1.21 in w9 and 1.14-1.21 in omaat_f60 (issue 5).

calibration.earlier_issue: w9a LOW / w9b LOW: the far LOD had no window wing or pier wood
calibration.status: fixed. Lines 346-347 add the pier and wing wood. One small LOD mismatch remains: far leaves start at 0.10 while the near leaves stand on a 0.16 plinth (issue 6).

calibration.earlier_issue: w9b MED: the leaves started too low, with no plinth, grip slot or chrome strip
calibration.status: fixed for open doors and wrong for closed doors. Line 236 sets ly0 0.16 with a bright foot strip (lines 249 and 259) and a black slot (line 250). With the doors open (s1, s6, v5) this matches up_34 and f60. With the doors closed (v1, v2), line 237 builds a proud taupe plinth across the doorway, and the slots travel with the leaves into it. Real (f60, up_34): the floor shows in dark shadow under the closed leaves, and the slots stay under the flanks at the outer ends (issues 2 and 3).

calibration.earlier_issue: w9a / w9b out of scope: horizontal tweed too light, large navy plaque, hard sun patches, studio-washed handset screen
calibration.status: not fixed (other owners). q03 ottoman/pier-wood is 130/67 = 1.94, against 1.18 in omaat_f11 (117/99). q04 still has the large navy 1A tile and hard-edged sun patches.

details.detail: Aisle face, doors open: fluted leaves, frames, pulls, LEDs, plinth with chrome strip and slot, wood flanks
Window screen wall: rounded wing and rim, 43-in screen, cap
Window pier: rounded-rect mirror in a light frame, lamp
Centre pair: board, fin edge, 2D pier and mirror, lowered and raised divider
Console: fascia, tapered wood insert, low module, keypad, handset dock
Seat: back, flap, seams, 0.12 niche header with lamps, pillow, armrest
Bed: pad, duvet, turned corner, drape, belt, pillows
Colour and materials: cap/body two-tone, olive leaves, wood, tweed

issues.issue: The turned-down duvet corner (the w9 replacement for the fold band) is buried inside the duvet. Only thin light slivers poke out along the aisle and head edges, so the bed reads as a plain white slab with odd stepped edges. The omaat_f57 diagonal fold is not visible.
issues.evidence: Line 300: gExtrude(..., 0.022) is depth-centred (02_geo.js line 205) and rotated rx -90 deg at y 0.553, so it spans y 0.542-0.564. The duvet loft (line 296) has its plateau at 0.47 + 0.065 + 0.045 = 0.58, inset by edge 0.06. q04 crop qa10a/q04_bed.png: no triangle on the top; a light step at the aisle-head corner (crop x 110-390, y 440-520).
issues.fix: Line 300: put the triangle on the plateau, inset from the rounded edges, with a thin depth: B.add(gExtrude([[xe - 0.42, -dz0 + 0.06], [xe - 0.065, -dz0 + 0.06], [xe - 0.065, -dz0 + 0.40]], 0.008), M4.trs(0, 0.584, 0, 0, -Math.PI / 2), {c:'#e6e3dd', ...}), which gives y 0.580-0.588. Optionally add a thin dark crease line along its hypotenuse (gBox 0.004 high in '#bdb9b2', rotated 45 deg in plan) so the fold reads against the same-white duvet, as in f57.

issues.issue: With the doors closed, a proud taupe plinth runs across the doorway under the leaves. On the real suite the closed leaves hang over the open doorway, and below their chrome foot strip there is dark floor/shadow. The plinth exists only under the flanks and the parked leaves.
issues.evidence: omaat_f60: under the closed leaves (x 400-700, y 830-890) is #15150c L20, against the flank plinths at L46. up_34: the doorway floor is carpet with no step. v1: the under-door plinth is L119, the same as the side plinths (L117), so the base reads as one continuous step. Code line 237: if (doorsShut) gBox(0.03, ly0, zo1 - zo0 + 0.02) in fShell.
issues.fix: Line 237: delete the doorway plinth. If a closing face is needed, use a recessed dark toe-kick instead: B.add(gBox(0.01, ly0 - 0.01, zo1 - zo0), M4.trs(hx - 0.06, ly0 / 2, zm), SEATMAT.fConsoleLow), set 0.06 back so it reads as shadow.

issues.issue: The grip slots move with the leaves. When the doors are closed they end up under the doorway, but the real slots are fixed in the plinth under the parked-leaf positions, at its outer ends. They are also too thin: real is about 0.10 x 0.07, render 0.12 x 0.028.
issues.evidence: f60: the slots are at x 40-110 and 1010-1060, under the flanks. up_34: the slot under the parked leaf is about 60 x 45 px on a 300 px (0.50 m) leaf, so about 0.10 x 0.075. v1: the slots sit under the closed leaves. Code line 250 places the slot at z0 + 0.12 or z1 - 0.12 of each leaf.
issues.fix: Line 250: move the slot out of the leaf loop and fix it at the parked positions: for (const z of [-L + 0.22, -0.58]) B.add(gBox(0.004, 0.065, 0.10), M4.trs(hx + 0.001, 0.08, z), SEATMAT.black). Apply this for both door states.

issues.issue: The keypad renders lighter than the module it sits on. The real keypad is a dark smoked-glass panel, slightly darker than the console.
issues.evidence: q04: keypad L126 vs module L107-115 (1.1x). s4: keypad L152 vs module face L124 (1.23x). Real: omaat_f57 keypad L82 vs module L99 (0.83x), f58 98/110 (0.89x). Code line 176: c '#4a4642', r 0.6 with no layer, while fConsole has LAYER.plastic.
issues.fix: Line 176: { c: '#2f2d2b', r: 0.3 }. Then re-measure and aim for keypad/module of about 0.85.

issues.issue: The fluting has lost relief. The w9 groove easing (line 19) flattened the leaves, and the field is now light relative to the cap. The real leaves show a bold rib rhythm. Moire is still faintly present (wavy alias) at grazing angles in studio, so the easing did not buy much.
issues.evidence: Column-mean p90/p10 across a leaf: v1 w10 1.07-1.11, w9 1.21, omaat_f60 1.14-1.21. Cap/field: v1 193/94 = 2.05 vs f60 163/64 = 2.55. Wavy lines are visible in qa10a/s1leaf.png.
issues.fix: Line 19: fFlute '#4a483f' -> '#45433a' and fFluteGap '#424037' -> '#3c3a32' (gap/slat about 0.85, halfway back to w9). Moire is better handled by mip or LOD than by contrast: keep the 0.026 pitch (deliberate) and, if aliasing returns, drop l: LAYER.plastic from fFlute.

issues.issue: The console module's ends are still hard, flat triangular faces (a straight extrusion). The real module's ends blend into the console top with radiused edges.
issues.evidence: s4 (x 400-550, y 215-330) and s5 / v2 (x 130-240, y 150-215): a sharp wedge with vertical triangular ends. omaat_f57 crop (qa10a/f57_console.png): the raised section has rounded ends and a soft nose.
issues.fix: Line 172: extrude the profile 0.44 long. Add two 0.04 end pieces using the same outline flattened toward the trough, pts.map(([x, y]) => [x, 0.655 + 0.55 * (y - 0.655)]), at z -0.68 +/- 0.24, so the ends step down. Alternatively, cap each end with gRBox(xs1 - xo, y0 - 0.655, 0.04, 0.018, 2).

issues.issue: In the far LOD the leaves and flank start at 0.10, while the near unit's leaves stand on a 0.16 plinth, so the leaf foot jumps at the LOD switch.
issues.evidence: Code lines 343-344 (0.10 + (H - 0.115) / 2) vs line 236 (ly0 0.16). Visible only at the switch.
issues.fix: Lines 343-344: use y 0.16 + (H - 0.175) / 2 and height H - 0.175.

issues.issue: Out of scope, noted only: the ottoman tweed still reads too light against the wood; the large navy 1A / 2G plaques; hard sun patches on the bed; studio light washes the handset screen.
issues.evidence: q03 ottoman/pier wood 130/67 = 1.94 vs omaat_f11 117/99 = 1.18. The q04 plaque is a large navy tile; omaat_f58 shows a small dark-grey 2K plaque.
issues.fix: Lighting owner (12_scene.js / 04_shaders.js): less top fill on horizontal fabric and a softer sun-LUT penumbra. Seats owner (09_seats.js): plaque about 0.05 x 0.025, dark grey.

questions: Flute contrast versus moire: should the fluted leaves keep the bold rib relief of omaat_f60 (groove about 0.8x the slat) and accept a little shimmer, or stay flat as now (about 0.9x)?
With the doors closed, should the doorway show just the floor under the leaves (f60, up_34), or keep a closing face for picking or collision?
